_notes.method: Linear-light mean of a clean, evenly lit patch (10-90th luminance percentile; 'bright'/'dark'/'wood' pixel selectors for trims, black steel and beams). Interior shots are already close to neutral white balance (ceilings read #c3c2be), so interior values are as measured; they are camera-exposure values, so whites read ~#cfcdc8 rather than paint-chip white - scale up uniformly if your lighting expects true albedo.
